metadata.name: agreement
metadata.description: Urban Game Theory Agreement - escrow settled by a lens attestation (Solana)

errors.name: NotActive
errors.msg: The agreement is not Active

errors.name: NotAttested
errors.msg: No decision has been attested for this agreement

errors.name: DeadlinePassed
errors.msg: The agreement's deadline has passed

errors.name: DeadlineNotPassed
errors.msg: The agreement's deadline has not passed, or it has none

errors.name: Underfunded
errors.msg: The escrow holds less than the agreement's required funding

errors.name: WrongLens
errors.msg: The attestation was not issued by the agreement's lens

errors.name: InvalidAttestation
errors.msg: The account is not a valid SAS attestation or credential, or the credential's authority did not sign it

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the agreement's authority may do this

errors.name: CidTooLong
errors.msg: The CID is longer than 64 bytes

errors.name: InvalidCid
errors.msg: The CID must be 1-64 ASCII letters and digits

errors.name: NoLens
errors.msg: A lens key is required

errors.name: InvalidPayout
errors.msg: The payout must be a real account other than the agreement itself

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: WrongAuthority
errors.msg: The account is not the agreement's authority

errors.name: WrongPayout
errors.msg: The account is not the agreement's payout account

errors.name: AlreadyAttested
errors.msg: A decision is already recorded for this agreement

errors.name: DecisionSatisfied
errors.msg: The lens attested the decision as satisfied: the agreement can no longer be cancelled

errors.name: AttestationExpired
errors.msg: The attestation has expired

errors.name: WrongSchema
errors.msg: The attestation is not under its credential's AgreementDecision v1 schema

errors.name: InvalidAttestationPayload
errors.msg: The attestation payload does not match the AgreementDecision-v1 layout

errors.name: WrongAgreement
errors.msg: The attestation is about a different agreement

errors.name: InvalidDecision
errors.msg: The attested decision must be satisfied

errors.name: AttestationFromFuture
errors.msg: The attestation's source time is in the future

errors.name: ArithmeticOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: InsufficientEscrowBalance
errors.msg: Insufficient escrow balance

errors.name: WrongSponsor
errors.msg: The attestation names a different sponsor than the agreement's authority

errors.name: InvalidLens
errors.msg: A lens has 1-8 distinct real keys and a threshold between 1 and their number

errors.name: InvalidFundingTarget
errors.msg: A contribution target needs a mint, and a mint needs a target

errors.name: MemberAlreadyConfirmed
errors.msg: This lens member's confirmation is already recorded

errors.name: LensAlreadyConfirmed
errors.msg: Enough lens members have confirmed; only the contribution target is outstanding

errors.name: NoFundingTarget
errors.msg: The agreement has no contribution target

errors.name: FundingAlreadyConfirmed
errors.msg: The contribution target is already confirmed

errors.name: FundingTargetNotMet
errors.msg: Credited contributions are below the agreement's target

errors.name: InvalidEscrow
errors.msg: The account is not this agreement's donation escrow

errors.name: InvalidVault
errors.msg: The account is not the donation escrow's vault, or it does not back the credited contributions
